messages:
elaine_cs: quick heads-up — GammaApp onboarding hit intermittent 401s during SDK init. ~15-25% of initial requests fail, started right after they rotated a service account key. can we triage?

devon_se: thanks — do we have a request id or sample logs? sounds like token acceptance window or proxy caching.

devon_se: if they rotated keys, old tokens might still be in flight. any `x-request-id` or `x-auth-error` fields in logs?

eleine_cs: (typo) sorry, elaine_cs — attaching the snippet they pasted: ```
ERR auth=401 msg="unauthorized" svc=redwood client=gamma-sdk ts=2026-03-20T20:11:02Z req_id=gc-8f3b 
headers: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
x-auth-valid-until: 2026-03-20T20:10:59Z
```

elaine_cs: they also run behind a shared LB and use a small edge proxy for caching. not sure if it's mutating headers.

sam_runtime: hmm that `x-auth-valid-until` TTL looks right — but if LB/proxy is reusing connections it could be replaying an old Authorization header after rotation. are their SDKs fetching new tokens per process or caching in-memory?

devon_se: asked GammaApp: they said the browser SDK fetches ephemeral tokens from their auth service on each tab load, but their auth endpoint sometimes returns 500 for a short window during rotation. client retries and ends up with mixed tokens.

kevin_infra: quick hypothesis: our runtime sees valid tokens but the LB is stripping `x-auth-valid-until` when forwarding to the runtime, so validation defaults to current time -> 401. can we confirm header flow with a curl? run on their staging: ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Auth-Valid-Until: $EXP" https://their-proxy.example/echo-headers | jq .
```

elaine_cs: just ran their staging repro with devon on the call — output shows the LB returns the header to client but the request reaching our edge lacks `X-Auth-Valid-Until`. kevin, looks like your hypothesis stands.

kevin_infra: their HAProxy config has `http-request del-header X-Auth-Valid-Until` in one of the frontend rules (old workaround). ask them to remove that line or add `http-request set-header X-Auth-Valid-Until "%[req.hdr(X-Auth-Valid-Until)]"` to rewrite.

sam_runtime: short-term mitigation on our side: we can accept token timestamps coming from the Authorization JWT `exp` claim if `X-Auth-Valid-Until` missing for a 30s grace window. will push a tiny fallback patch to canary.

onboard-bot: ticket #CS-7894 created for GammaApp onboarding auth-jitter (assignee: devon_se).

elaine_cs: patched LB config and patched our canary. retested — failure rate dropped from ~20% to ~1.5%. customer reports SDK bootstraps reliably now.

devon_se: nice. next steps: schedule a 30-min enablement with GammaApp to review token rotation pattern and recommend backoff + jitter on their auth service. I'll own follow-up. :white_check_mark:

elaine_cs: thanks all, logging notes to the onboarding playbook and closing interim alert.
